import_detectron_ops: import Detectron custom ops into the Caffe2 workspace using dyndep InitOpsLibrary
create_suffix_net: create a new Caffe2 Net that includes only ops after a given prefix length
normalize_blob_name: remove name scoping from a blob reference to get the unscoped name
